faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.q1: How do you start a technical audit or consulting process?
faq.a1: We perform an initial assessment of your processes and infrastructure to identify bottlenecks and prioritize opportunities.
faq.q2: Do you work with legacy systems?
faq.a2: Yes, we design API-based integration architectures to connect legacy platforms with modern cloud solutions.
faq.a3: We offer turnkey projects or continuous consulting via technical sprints depending on your IT ecosystem complexity.
faq.q4: How do you guarantee user adoption?
faq.a4: We design clean B2B interfaces focusing on functional usabilty and provide team onboarding during deployment.
